description: Changes this conversation's active strategy workspace to another strategy owned by the user. Use only when the user explicitly asks to work with, compare against, copy from, or move to a different strategy. If the user explicitly names or identifies a different owned strategy, that explicit target beats the currently open page/context; resolve the named strategy first and switch only when the user is actually moving the workspace target. If revisionId is omitted, the newest accessible revision is selected. This does not copy files by itself; use file tools after switching or when reading another owned strategy.

aiStrategyId.description: Target AiStrategy.id. Use list_strategies to resolve this when the user names a different strategy.

revisionId.description: Optional target revision id. Omit when switching by strategy name unless the user explicitly asked for a specific version; the newest target revision will be selected.

strategyId.description: Target Strategy.id. Use list_strategies to resolve this when the user names a different strategy.

name: switch_active_strategy
title: Switch active strategy
